title: Law School Early Decision EV Engine
description: Computes the expected value of binding Early Decision vs. a Regular Decision portfolio for law school: ED admission boost by median position (splitter logic), forfeited scholarship negotiation leverage, break-even ED boost, ED guarantee programs, and debt/payment impact.
data_vintage: LSAC 2024 median LSAT by school tier · NALP 2024 BigLaw salary data · ABA 509 data 2024 scholarship rates · LSAC ED policy survey 2024
regulatory_citations: LSAC 2024 binding Early Decision program policies
LSAC 2024 median LSAT scores by school tier

mcp_tool_definition.name: evaluate_law_ed_tradeoff
mcp_tool_definition.description: Evaluate binding Early Decision vs. Regular Decision for a law school applicant: returns EV of each path, ED admit-probability boost by median position (above/splitter/below), forfeited scholarship negotiation leverage in dollars, break-even ED boost, net cost and monthly payment under each path, and a sensitivity strip across boost assumptions.

ed_target_tier.description: Tier of the single binding ED target school

rd_portfolio_size.description: Number of same-tier schools in the Regular Decision portfolio

risk_tolerance.description: Risk profile applied to the verdict (certainty premium vs. leverage weighting)

loan_rate_pct.description: Expected student loan interest rate, percent (Grad PLUS 2024-25: 9.08%)

ed_guarantee.description: Whether the ED target offers a scholarship guarantee program (e.g., NYU / Chicago-style full-tuition ED guarantee)

ed_guarantee_amount.description: Guaranteed ED scholarship, total dollars over 3 years (used only if ed_guarantee is true)

input_schema_summary: LSAT score, GPA, ED target tier (T14/T15-50/Regional), career track (BigLaw/in-house/government/public interest), RD portfolio size, risk tolerance, loan rate, optional ED scholarship guarantee amount
output_schema_summary: EV(ED) and EV(RD) in 10-yr NPV dollars, EV gap and verdict, P(admit) RD vs ED with boost in pp by median position, forfeited negotiation leverage, break-even ED boost, net cost and 10-yr monthly payment per path, fallback-tier odds and NPV, sensitivity strip at +5/10/15/20pp boosts
